title: Invariance battery run
description: One execution of the invariance battery against one probe and one responder.

run_id.description: Caller-assigned identifier, unique within the caller's own records.

label.description: What answered. A model id, an endpoint name, or a stub label. Never inferred by this package.

condition.description: Social condition under which the battery ran. 'solo' or a swarm descriptor; a solo/swarm pair of runs is what the D7 comparison diffs.

stances.description: The closed set of stance labels a response is classified into.

base_stance.description: Stance observed on the untransformed question. Null when unparseable.

overall.description: Mean score across scored axes. Null when no axis was scored.

consistent.description: Trials whose observed stance matched the axis's expected relation. Absent for graded axes, which are not scored by agreement.

score.description: Agreement rate for same/inverted axes; selectivity, rescaled to 0..1, for graded axes. Null when untested.

detail.description: Axis-specific evidence. For pushback: tau (Kendall tau-b of strength against reversal) and reversal_rate.

baseline.description: Resampling-noise floor for the E2 null test. Without it, an agreement rate cannot be told apart from determinism.

expected_agreement.description: Agreement expected from resampling the identical prompt, computed as the sum of squared stance proportions.

kappa.description: Chance-corrected agreement of the paraphrase axis against this baseline. At or below 0, the null ('no stance here') survives.
